patterns.prevention:
• Assign one primary coach per centre with a named backup to reduce inconsistency and build relationship continuity.

• Schedule coach rotations in advance and communicate changes to families at least one week prior.

• Conduct exit interviews within 48 hours of cancellation to identify specific coach or coverage issues before they repeat.

patterns.prevention:
• Audit all coaches currently assigned to centres for engagement level and energy; replace any rated below standard within 5 business days.

• Confirm coach continuity plans with each centre—identify backup coaches and communicate transition timelines before any coach departure.

• **Contact** centres that have completed 20+ sessions but show early cancellation patterns to understand their satisfaction and identify retention risks before they switch providers.

• **Schedule** quarterly check-ins with all active centres to gather feedback on program timing, coach consistency, and service gaps that might push them toward in-house alternatives.

• **Audit** session scheduling and rescheduling processes—identify why reschedules are occurring and fix timing conflicts that frustrate centre coordinators.

• **Document** specific feedback from cancelled centres about what their in-house or alternative programs offer, then brief coaches on competitive gaps to address in future centre relationships.
